<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916371_theRebbe_639" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916371_theRebbe_639__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the difference between a general call to God and a true call through Torah, which brings a deeper closeness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And there is to add explanation in what is said in the continuation of the verse, “to all who call Him in truth,”</t>
    <t s="1">for the matter of “close to all who call Him” equally</t>
    <t s="2">is from the aspect of a simple call,</t>
    <t s="3">an external call,</t>
    <t s="4">and above this is the closeness to “all who call Him in truth,”</t>
    <t s="5">which is the matter of an inner call,</t>
    <t s="6">which is a call in truth,</t>
    <t s="7">for then He is close in the utmost way,</t>
    <t s="8">and as explained elsewhere22</t>
    <t s="9">that “they call Him in truth” refers to the Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">“there is no truth but Torah,”23</t>
    <t s="11">for specifically through the Torah is the inner drawing down.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the revelation of the level of Havayah above required the Exodus and the Giving of the Torah, drawing from a higher source beyond limitation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this24 there is to explain with additional elucidation the connection of the revelation of Havayah above to the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">for in order for there to be a descent also to the lower ones</t>
    <t s="3">(which was innovated at the Giving of the Torah)</t>
    <t s="4">there must be a drawing down from a more elevated aspect.</t>
    <t s="5">In the manner explained in the maamar, that in order for there to be “the God of the King” and especially “and I will bless Your name forever and ever,” there must be “I will exalt You.”</t>
    <t s="6">And this is “And God spoke to Moshe and said to him, ‘I am Havayah,’”</t>
    <t s="7">that initially the revelation of the Name Havayah was specifically through the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="8">and “My Name Havayah above I was not known to them.”</t>
    <t s="9">But in order to take Israel out of Egypt and for there to be the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">there must be drawn from a higher place,</t>
    <t s="11">from the aspect of Havayah above.</t>
    <t s="12">It is written,25</t>
    <t s="13">“Great is Havayah and exceedingly praised in the city of our God,”</t>
    <t s="14">and our sages, of blessed memory, said,26</t>
    <t s="15">“When is He great? When He is in the city of our God,”</t>
    <t s="16">that through the city of our God27</t>
    <t s="17">Havayah comes in a multiplicity of divisions to bring into being a multitude of creations,</t>
    <t s="18">“How manifold are Your works, Havayah!”28</t>
    <t s="19">(and also the bringing into being of “How great are Your works, Havayah!”29</t>
    <t s="20">is specifically through His coming into the city of our God).</t>
    <t s="21">However, the aspect of Havayah in His own essence is above division,</t>
    <t s="22">“He was, He is, and He will be as one,”30</t>
    <t s="23">and even to simple unity,</t>
    <t s="24">which is “and to His greatness there is no investigation,”31</t>
    <t s="25">which is the aspect of the greatness of Havayah in His own essence.</t>
    <t s="26">And behold, the aspect of the Name Havayah as it is contracted through the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="27">since it is a contracted and limited light,</t>
    <t s="28">is drawn only to Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="29">and in order for it to be drawn also below into the worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,</t>
    <t s="30">and even to this lowest world, beneath which there is no lower32</t>
    <t s="31">(the connection of the upper and lower that was innovated at the Giving of the Torah),</t>
    <t s="32">there must be drawn the Name Havayah that is above vestiture in the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="33">which is the aspect of Havayah above.</t>
    <t s="34">And based on this will be understood what Rashi explained: “I was not known to them in My attribute of truth,”</t>
    <t s="35">for seemingly, how can it be said that the attribute of truth was not revealed to the Patriarchs,</t>
    <t s="36">and especially to Yaakov, whose attribute is the attribute of truth?33</t>
    <t s="37">Rather, the intention is that the aspect of Havayah above was not revealed to them,</t>
    <t s="38">which is specifically His attribute of truth,</t>
    <t s="39">in the manner of what is said, “You give truth to Yaakov,”34</t>
    <t s="40">that even to Yaakov, whose attribute is the attribute of truth,</t>
    <t s="41">there is need to draw down the aspect of the supernal truth, the truth of Havayah.35</t>
    <t s="42">And this is what was innovated at the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="43">that the aspect of the Name Havayah above shone then,</t>
    <t s="44">and more particularly,</t>
    <t s="45">the Name Havayah of the aspect of Atik.</t>
    <t s="46">And likewise it will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="47">as it is said,36</t>
    <t s="48">“As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,”</t>
    <t s="49">that there will then be a revelation of the Name Havayah above,</t>
    <t s="50">the aspect of “My attribute of truth,”</t>
    <t s="51">and even more than at the time of the Exodus from Egypt,37</t>
    <t s="52">for “I will show him the wonders” that at the Exodus from Egypt “and My face shall not be seen.”38</t>
    <t s="53">And behold, all the revelations of the future depend39</t>
    <t s="54">on our deeds and service during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="55">therefore now the service must be above measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="56">in the manner of the statement of our sages, of blessed memory, on the verse “And I appeared,” that the service must be in a manner of “they did not question,”40</t>
    <t s="57">“and I am Havayah,”</t>
    <t s="58">faithful41</t>
    <t s="59">to pay a good reward and to fulfill His promises, “and I will take you out, and I will save, and I will redeem, and I will take,”42</t>
    <t s="60">— which was said to Moshe, the faithful shepherd,</t>
    <t s="61">“He is the first redeemer, He is the final redeemer,”43</t>
    <t s="62">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="63">speedily in our days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
